set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H01
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/identity lead
Scope: Existing curator authority must become explicit current stewardship without widening migrated access.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Lab/project/membership/placement records and migrated legacy datasets agree across reference, PostgreSQL and public APIs; historical IDs, custody and attribution remain intact.
2. Actual browser sessions, guest admission, expiry and disablement exercise the 38 ADR scenarios plus concurrent last-steward transfer; the old curator field supplies no authorization bypass.
3. Directories, counts, suggestions, history, receipts, cached results and active delivery obey current scope; fixed-release guests cannot learn newer heads or restricted source evidence. Local provider evidence is clearly separate from F04.4.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H01/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- F02: bd-01M4W40JE6XGVG1R6TSQQZ6P6S
- F03: bd-01M4W40JJBE0KQ3K3H365X8033
- F04.3: bd-01M4W5P64ZQD531177ZZKYVC4K
- F05: bd-01M4W40JSS0HZY131BNTKV1QF3
- F06: bd-01M4W40JXJ4C805E7NBZ0WCDMF

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H01: Review core: Governed catalog and current access
